# ICAR ADE v1.5.1 JSON schemas (vendored)

Unmodified copies of the resources, types and enums reachable from the ADE resources Orbit maps
(see `src/ade.ts`), taken from https://github.com/adewg/ICAR at tag `v1.5.1`.
